sentences.text: Hush... I drifted through the house, feeling only the quiet anticipation before 05:30.
I could sense how low the expected reading was, barely 50 Wh.
But then, my little crystal ball trembled as the machines began waking up.
The energy roared suddenly, spiking to 360 Wh, shattering the expected range of 39 Wh to 76 Wh.
This sudden, vibrant presence held the house captive until 06:00.
